{{Quote|I've got a friend who says that hokey religions and ancient weapons are no match for a good blaster at your side. That goes for stun whips, too.|Luke Skywalker to Dors Stelikag|<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
A '''Stun whip''' was a type of weapon.<ref name="COO" //>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Battle for Poln Major|mission]] to the  [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] claimed to possess a stun whip concealed within his belt while confronting a hostile group affiliated with [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]].
